choices.result: The printer works. Henri asks you not to mention his technical skills to the whole delegation.

choices.label: Issue the printer a formal protest.
choices.result: Henri files the protest under 'mechanical correspondence'.

a.text: Malta's brief is in the blue folder. Cyprus and Luxembourg authorised me to present their positions at the budget-share meeting; their briefs are in green and yellow.

choices.label: Ask what each mission actually wants.
choices.result: Tanya explains all three positions separately and thanks you for not calling them a single brief.

choices.label: Suggest combining the folders to save time.
choices.result: Tanya hands you a third folder labelled 'permission'. It is empty.

a.text: Tanya taps an intricate rhythm on the meeting table. It is the most decisive thing the table has heard all morning.

choices.label: Ask about the rhythm.
choices.result: Tanya describes her old band and offers to make the next reception considerably louder.

choices.label: Ask if the rhythm can shorten the speeches.
choices.result: Tanya suggests a drum solo after the first seven minutes of each intervention.

a.text: Lars has marked every absent mission on the agenda. There are more pencil notes than agenda items.

choices.label: Check who authorised a representative.
choices.result: Lars marks the authorised proxies and leaves the others blank until they respond.

choices.label: Declare everyone present by consensus.
choices.result: Lars asks whether the empty chairs agreed to that wording.

a.text: Lars says the evening card game is strictly informal. The seating chart suggests otherwise.

choices.label: Ask to join without bringing briefing notes.
choices.result: Lars approves, then produces a very formal deck of cards.

choices.label: Ask whether the cards use qualified majority voting.
choices.result: Lars deals you a rulebook and the oldest deck in the building.

a.text: Mira unfolds a port map marked with collection routes. Donors keep asking where to stand for the photograph.

choices.label: Ask which route needs attention.
choices.result: Mira identifies a blocked collection point and thanks you for asking.

choices.label: Ask where the logo will be visible.
choices.result: Mira points to the bin currently blocking the route.

a.text: Mira says port crews have practical ideas but rarely appear in project announcements.

choices.label: Ask to hear the crews’ suggestions.
choices.result: Mira offers to arrange a practical briefing.

choices.label: Suggest a larger ceremonial ribbon.
choices.result: Mira measures the ribbon against the blocked drain.

a.text: Sofia knows which insurers will cover port cargo, but needs reliable collection records before recommending a contract.

choices.label: Ask what records would help.
choices.result: Sofia outlines a useful manifest and introduces you to a port contact.

choices.label: Promise perfect records without checking.
choices.result: Sofia asks whether your promise is insured.

a.text: Sofia organises a Portuguese reception and is deciding between a maritime insurer and a musician for the last seat.

choices.label: Suggest inviting both for different parts of the evening.
choices.result: Sofia finds room in the programme for a conversation and a song.

choices.label: Reserve the seat for your own delegation.
choices.result: Sofia notes your request in a very small notebook.

a.text: Idra is tracking donated bins stuck in customs. Each agency has produced a separate spreadsheet.

choices.label: Compare the shipment numbers together.
choices.result: Idra spots a duplicate entry and finds the correct customs file.

choices.label: Suggest another inter-agency spreadsheet.
choices.result: Idra adds your suggestion to the spreadsheet of spreadsheets.

a.text: Idra wants local crews involved before donors announce another programme.

choices.label: Ask who will maintain the equipment.
choices.result: Idra shares the maintenance plan and makes a note to include the crews.

choices.label: Ask when the launch photograph is.
choices.result: Idra checks the camera budget, then points to the empty maintenance line.
